honesty: Truthfulness in word and deed. Lies and taking things unasked lower it; keeping your word and owning mistakes raise it.
compassion: Care for the people and creatures here. Kindness raises it; cruelty and indifference lower it.
curiosity: The urge to look closer, ask, and go where nobody sent you. Exploring, questioning, and experimenting raise it.
patience: Willingness to wait, listen, and let things unfold. Listening to the end, waiting for the right moment, and slow attention raise it; hurrying and interrupting lower it.
mischief: Pranks, provocations, and delight in disorder. Rises with every trick played and every rule bent for fun.
generosity: Giving without being asked and without expecting return. Sharing raises it; hoarding and haggling lower it.
